## 2. 离线复测（必填）

```bash
# 改前
python -m pytest tests/ -q > /tmp/ainovel-before.log 2>&1 || true
grep '^FAILED' /tmp/ainovel-before.log | sort > /tmp/ainovel-before-failed.txt

# 改后
python -m pytest tests/ -q > /tmp/ainovel-after.log 2>&1 || true
grep '^FAILED' /tmp/ainovel-after.log | sort > /tmp/ainovel-after-failed.txt

diff /tmp/ainovel-before-failed.txt /tmp/ainovel-after-failed.txt
```
